subject: Request: trial extension + top-up credit for Talon Security evaluation

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@talonsec.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial extension + top-up credit request

Hi Neha,

Quick note — our evaluation with Redwood hit a snag this week: a critical SME was pulled into a compliance audit, so the PoC that was supposed to finish Friday has been delayed by a week. We still plan to move forward but will need a little more runway to finish the integration and run quality checks.

Can you help with either: (a) a 7–10 day extension of the trial window, or (b) a one-time trial credit top-up (~$200) we can apply to our org to continue tests?

We’ve used ~18k tokens to date (see attached usage export) and expect another ~40–60k for the full test matrix. We’re on the self-serve flow, so a promo code would be easiest for our team.

Thanks — appreciate any help.

Olivia Chen
Senior Engineer, Talon Security
olivia.chen@talonsec.com

Attachments: evaluation-usage.csv (CSV export from dashboard)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding a small request from Talon Security (Olivia). They’re mid-eval and need a short runway or a modest credit. Usage looks light but the timeline slipped due to internal audit.

Key numbers: ~18k tokens consumed, expect +50k to finish. They’re on self-serve signup (no dedicated rep billing).

Options I recommend: one-time $200 promo code (single-use org credit) OR 10-day extension on trial expiry. Given they look like a likely mid-market account and we’d prefer to keep them in test, I’m leaning toward issuing a small promo code to avoid changing trial workflows.

Attaching the usage csv for context. Please advise approval and any constraints (expiry / eligible models / single-use). If approved, Karthik can generate and send the code.

—Neha

Karthik — please record this as a promotional issuance in the finance tracker and include the approval PDF (I attached a signed stub). Neha — once you have the code, share it with Olivia and include clear redemption steps + expiry date.

Subject: Trial credit issued — Talon Security (REDWOOD-TRIAL-250-2026A)

Hi Olivia — good news, we approved a one-time top-up for Talon Security. Details below and instructions to redeem.

Promo code: REDWOOD-TRIAL-250-2026A
Amount: $250 USD credit applied to hosted API usage
Expires: 2026-10-08 23:59 UTC (90 days from issuance)
Eligibility: Single-use, org-level; will apply automatically when used from your org account on the self-serve console.
Restrictions: Not valid for Dedicated/Private billing. Cannot be stacked with other active promos.

How to redeem:
1) Sign in to https://console.redwood.ai (use the org admin account).
2) Open Billing > Apply Promo Code and paste REDWOOD-TRIAL-250-2026A.
3) The credit will appear on your billing page and be consumed against hosted API usage.

If you prefer, I can apply the credit for you — I’ll just need a confirmation email from your procurement contact. Also happy to schedule a quick 30m session next week to review metrics and remaining test cases.

Thanks — and apologies again for the timeline slip; we want to make sure you can complete the evaluation.

—Neha Kapoor
